obligations.description: Review CausalGeometry architecture, dependency boundaries, invariants and obligation-to-implementation mapping without delegating closure to scripts.
Perform an obligation-by-obligation adversarial review, including negative cases and accidental-complexity inspection.
Run representative scaling/resource measurements and record time, peak memory, allocations/copies and empirical scaling; compilation alone is not performance certification.
Manually reconcile planned obligations against implementation and executable evidence before declaring a campaign or release closed.
Maintain explicit definitions, theorem statements, dependencies and proof obligations for the causal-geometry theory.
When executable or formal artifacts are introduced, add their toolchain here rather than marking prose-level arguments as machine-checked.
